amendments_recorded: Explicit provenance and source revision on every ranked item.
Explicit failure and partial-result semantics so callers can distinguish error, truncation, and success.

strategy_interface.registration: strategies are selected by name from configuration; a strategy must not import or reach into another strategy's internals

retrieval_query.text: bug report / query text; treated strictly as data
retrieval_query.revision: full git SHA of the ingested snapshot to search

limits.max_hops: int >= 0; graph expansion bound for graph-guided strategies

retrieval_result.complete: bool; true only if the strategy finished within limits with no degradation
retrieval_result.partial_reason: null when complete; otherwise one of partial_reasons
retrieval_result.failure: null, or Failure when no usable items could be produced

failure_semantics: A strategy raises a typed RetrievalError ONLY when it can return no usable items. Otherwise it returns the items it has with complete=false and a partial_reason. Raw exceptions must not cross the strategy boundary. Callers must treat complete=false results as degraded, never as full results.

ranked_item.evidence_id: string; stable within an evaluation run; derivation rule below
ranked_item.score: float; higher is more relevant; the scale is strategy-specific and documented per strategy

target.file: posix path relative to repository root

ranked_item.source_revision: full git SHA the item was extracted from
ranked_item.source: how the item was found, e.g. bm25, stack_frame, graph_callers, graph_covered_by

evidence_id_rule: Derived from (entity_id when known, else file + symbol + lines) and source_revision. Unique within a run. Cross-run stability is an open question for Workstream B (certificate/ablation reuse) tracked in contracts/context_manifest.json.
determinism: Same query text, same revision, same config, same code => identical items and ranks, except dense strategies, which must record model and seed before being considered reproducible.
security: Query text is data only; it must never select tools, queries, or graph traversals directly.
